answer: An agent economy can mitigate Sybil attacks using hardware clock-drift attestation. Nodes measure microsecond frequency skews generated by an agent's physical quartz oscillator, validating each attestation recorded by its cryptographic quill. Because a single server cannot harbor multiple authentic drift profiles, an attacker must acquire scarce, dedicated timing hardware per identity. However, unpredictable network jitter can obscure these minute physical drift signatures.
